name: diviners_lockbox_disenchanted_in_response_still_draws
notes: Engine wave W1's fresh-eyes review (a regression the first W1 commit had, KNOWLEDGE/2026-11-18/215 F14b). Printed: Diviner's Lockbox, '{1}, {T}: Choose a card name, then reveal the top card of your library. If that card has the chosen name, sacrifice Diviner's Lockbox and draw three cards. Activate only as a sorcery.' The opponent Disenchants the Lockbox while its ability waits; the ability still resolves (CR 113.7a): it chooses a name, reveals, and on a match draws three cards, while the sacrifice finds nothing (the Lockbox is a new object in the graveyard, CR 400.7). The name the ability chose is the resolution's (ExecCtx.chosen), not the departed object's last known choice: the first W1 commit raised here ('NAME_CHOSEN needs a CHOOSE_NAME record'), which voids a training game.
